name: War-Awoken End of Life (Weapon Skill)
effects:
One single piercing attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1] & [Instant Cast 1] to user.
[Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)] & [Fire Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)] to user, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has Attach Fire 0-1/2
WS Blue: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to user
WS Gold: Chases a Fire ability with [200% ATB 3] (max 1 chase) to user
